instructions: Gut the sardines and pull off the heads, or ask the fishmonger to. Rinse them and pat very dry with paper towels.
Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large nonstick skillet or griddle over high heat until very hot.
Add half the sardines in a single layer and turn the heat down to medium. Cook 3 minutes per side, until golden and the flesh is opaque. Transfer to a platter.
Wipe the pan, heat the remaining 1 tbsp oil and cook the second batch the same way.
Sprinkle the coarse salt over the sardines. Cut the lemons into wedges and serve them with the sardines.
method_notes: Directo al Paladar's pan-grilled sardines (28 votes, no average shown) lead as a fallback: very hot oiled pan, about 3 minutes a side, coarse salt after. Okdiario's version soaks the fish in iced salt water for an hour and cooks 1.5 minutes a side; that soak was left out to keep the dish quick. The source is written for one person with 5 large sardines, so 2 lb of fresh sardines is used for four. Lemon comes from Okdiario and the list's description.
